verdict.rationale: Model-performance measurement and shadow-mode testing are fair questions for a fraud-decisioning platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers decision APIs, webhooks, chargebacks and configuring Decision Center policies at checkpoints. Nothing documents precision/recall reporting on merchant traffic or shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can measure the model itself — precision and recall on my traffic, shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions
